practice_questions.question_text: Construct an SQL query returning SupplierID and ProductName for products whose Description contains "fruity" and whose stock quantity is25–35 inclusive. Tables:Product(ProductID, SupplierID, ProductName, Description), Stock(ProductID, Quantity). Join using ProductID.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Add required two-table join while preserving range/substring query reasoning. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: SELECT P.SupplierID,P.ProductName FROM Product P JOIN Stock S ON P.ProductID=S.ProductID WHERE S.Quantity BETWEEN 25 AND 35 AND P.Description LIKE'%fruity%';
